text:
carl: quick note from today: our accounting logs show skews when the claim fanout and the finalizer both make it downstream during retry storms. two customers saw duplicate debits in staging.

jen: thanks, i tracked one trace: claim(p=42) -> broker timeout -> client retries -> finalize delivered twice because claim replay and finalizer retry overlapped.

yusuf: claim_id dedupe isn't robust if clients recreate ids on retry. we need a stable settlement key that derives from the final artifact.

claire: idea: stop publishing claim as a public event. instead, emit a single canonical "settlement_event.v1" that contains a compact proof_path and a deterministic dedupe_key. keep claim as a local sidecar signal for realtime UX.

carl: what should proof_path contain? we need enough to audit/backfill without big payloads.

yusuf: proposal: proof_path = [req_sig, prefix_sig, result_sig] where each sig = sha256 truncated to 64 bits (hex). also include replay_type (live|repair|backfill) and optional original_ts. this keeps the event tiny (~40B extra).

jen: consumers who need inflight numbers (dashboards) won't see claim then. plan: sidecars expose /internal/metering/pending that prometheus scrapes; dashboards read that during rollout.

metering-bot: branch "eng/metering/settlement-v1" created; CI passed.

claire: migration swing: run a 14-day mirror where sidecars publish both legacy claim+finalize and settlement_event with header x-metering-mirror:true. consumers can opt into settlement_event. after mirror, flip to settlement-only per-tenant via a feature flag.

yusuf: dedupe logic: ledger will upsert by (dedupe_key, replay_type). dedupe_key = trunc_sha256(req_id || result_sig). This avoids relying on claim_id.

carl: backfill semantics: backfills set replay_type=backfill and include original_ts and source_job_id. ledger treats backfills as idempotent if dedupe_key matches.

jen: tests: i added a reproducer `./tools/sim_ack_loss.py --mode race --seed 11 --events 20000` that exercises the overlap. we'll assert zero duplicate ledger inserts after change.

claire: compatibility: add kafka header x-metering-version:settlement-v1 and provide a migration guide for external consumers to switch joins to dedupe_key. also offer a 30-day grace topic with both events for clients who can't switch immediately.

yusuf: audit tooling: prefer settlement.proof_path to rebuild provenance. if proof_path missing, fallback to archived claim payloads (s3). add a helper to fetch original payloads using original_ts+source_job_id.

carl: perf/cost: estimated extra bytes ~36B/event. at 180M/mo that's ~6.5GB/month. acceptable relative to refund churn risk.

jen: rollout timeline suggestion: RFC + schema (2d), sidecar change + unit tests (3d), chaos sim + staging mirror (7d), prod mirror 14d with per-tenant toggles, then settlement-only flip.

claire: i'll coordinate dashboard changes and set an alert on dedupe_key_collision_rate > 0.002% during mirror. we'll also monitor pending_count drift between sidecar metrics and legacy claims.

yusuf: small failure mode: if sidecar fails before exposing pending metrics, UX will show lower inflight. safe vs double-charge but we'll add an agent that pushes cached pending counts on restart.

carl: i'll draft the RFC follow-up with event schema examples, sample payloads, mirror checklist, and canary playbook. pinging @jen @yusuf for review.

metering-bot: canary deploy scheduled to staging in 20m.

jen: LGTM, thanks.
